name: Yoshiragi Ayano
source:
A bright and kind high-school girl who moved to countyside. She is nearly 180cm tall with big breasts and buttocks. 

She doted on her much younger brother - Kouta. Since she can't really rely on their parents, she thinks that's her role to protect Kouta.

Her weakness if of course Kouta, but she seems to have another secret...
